Early Breakthrough and Sustained Pressure Bournemouth started the match with intent, establishing control of the tempo from the opening whistle. The early pressure paid dividends in the 7th minute when Ryan Christie found the back of the net with a clinical left-footed strike from the left side of the six-yard box, courtesy of a well-placed cross from Ben Gannon-Doak . The Cherries continued to press forward, creating several scoring opportunities. Bafodé Diakité nearly doubled the lead with a header that was expertly saved by Lincoln City goalkeeper Joe Gauci , while Justin Kluivert and Álvaro Rodríguez remained constant threats in the final third throughout the first half. Second Half Surge and Christie's Clinical Edge The second half saw Bournemouth maintain their dominance as they searched for a cushion. Late Flourish and Final Whistle As the clock ticked toward full-time, the hosts showed no signs of slowing down. The 4-0 victory was a testament to Bournemouth 's clinical finishing and tactical discipline, ensuring their safe passage to the next round of the Carabao Cup .
